ap_name.description: Name used for the AP hotspot and ZeroConf hostname; supports placeholders like <nnn> and <hostname>

ap_password.description: Password for WPA-PSK AP hotspot (8–63 characters); empty means open hotspot

web_service.description: Systemd service name to manage (disable when in hotspot mode, enable otherwise)

service_name.description: mdns service name to advertise (appended with '._tcp')

enable_appliance_mode.description: Enable dual-WiFi appliance mode with NAT and hotspot forwarding

external_callback.description: Path to executable script called on state changes (args: HOTSPOT|CONNECTING|CONNECTED)

primary_wifi_device.description: Override default primary WiFi interface (used for AP)

verbose.description: Verbose logging level; 0 = minimal, higher values increase verbosity

enable_nuke.description: Enable hardware nuke feature (short pins 39–40 on Raspberry Pi for 3s to reset config)

ipv6_link_local.description: Force link-local IPv6 only on upstream connections (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled)
